purpose: Announce the integrations catalog with an animated icon cluster

responsive.phone: Icon-tile hero row sits with zero bottom padding (tablet:pb-0 rule; phone shares this floor), tight top padding.
responsive.tablet: Content gap narrows to 30px (tablet:gap-[30px]); heading steps to tablet:text-title-t; decorative overlay gets a top-20 offset (tablet:top-20).
responsive.desktop: Content gap widens to 80px (desktop:gap-20); heading steps to desktop:text-title with desktop:text-body-l; outer padding widens (desktop:px-40).
